material_validation_blockers.finding: The trolley cover checker fragments into angular triangles with abrupt orientation and scale changes; orderly cabinet front mapping does not approve the cover.

highest_impact_repairs.repair: Establish continuous textile coordinates on the drape, with intentional seams and comparable checker scale over top and hanging sides; recheck the lit cover in both evidence and trolley views.

highest_impact_repairs.finding: Trolley cover reads as stiff regular humps and a planar skirt; chair pads remain too close in smooth response to rigid office surfaces.
highest_impact_repairs.repair: Use broad gravity-driven drape, hem/thickness and compression at straps; clarify soft upholstery or vinyl against molded plastic and painted supports, without gameplay-scale weave noise.

highest_impact_repairs.finding: Floor and yellow route markings remain nearly pristine; painted working equipment shows little visible causal contact wear.
highest_impact_repairs.repair: Author restrained wheel/contact bands, threshold scuffs, locally interrupted paint and touch wear at working handles, locks and cargo edges; avoid blanket dirt and uniform edge wear.

highest_impact_repairs.finding: Several broad painted, mineral, plastic and upholstered surfaces depend too heavily on colour and silhouette for identity at ordinary camera distance.
highest_impact_repairs.repair: Strengthen controlled material-specific response, low-frequency variation and sparse purposeful repairs; retain useful bare-metal glints and the successful navy/cream/rust/yellow hierarchy.

strengths: Spawn-related navy, cream, rust-orange and restrained hazard yellow remain coherent; small status and screen accents stay functional.
Bare counter hardware, silver trim and trolley pole have tighter highlights than broad painted bodies.
Paper reads matte and glass has a recognisable hazy reflective response.
Plaster-like close-range relief is visible, with no blanket photographic grunge or scratch noise.

evidence.failed_diagnostic_reason: Near-black exposure prevented useful material/checker inspection; confirmed diagnostic-only replacement frames were subsequently opened.
